name: harness-plugins
description: Claude Code plugins by Sreeram Ramasubramanian

plugins.name: review-layer
plugins.description: Mark up any HTML page Claude writes: comment in Chrome, then have Claude act on the comments and reply in the page

plugins.name: task-dispatch
plugins.description: Work through a tracked task list, from bd beads or a Markdown checklist, by sending each task to a fresh worker agent that commits and reports back

plugins.name: pre-pr-test-coverage
plugins.description: Pre-PR test coverage check for Python repos: coverage.py numbers plus deterministic signals (untested endpoints, ghost tests, quality gates) against a saved baseline
